name: Knotless Box Braids — Medium
shortDesc: Lightweight knotless braids with a natural, scalp-friendly start.
description: Knotless box braids start with your natural hair and gradually feed in extensions, giving a flatter, lighter, and more scalp-friendly look than traditional box braids. Medium thickness sits in the sweet spot of style longevity and install time.

name: Knotless Box Braids — Small
shortDesc: Smaller parts for a fuller, longer-lasting style.
description: Small knotless braids give a denser look that lasts longer between installs. Plan a full day for this style — it is worth every minute.

name: Boho Knotless with Curls
shortDesc: Knotless braids with curly human-hair accents woven in.
description: A romantic, free-spirited take on knotless braids: human hair curls are woven through to soften the silhouette. Pick your curl color when booking.

name: Feed-In Cornrows
shortDesc: Sleek, custom cornrow designs with feed-in extensions.
description: Tell me your design — straight back, zig-zag, hearts, or freestyle. Feed-in extensions blend seamlessly with your natural hair.

name: Passion Twists
shortDesc: Bohemian twists with a soft, wavy texture.
description: Passion twists use water-wave hair for a soft, romantic look that feels lightweight all day.

name: Senegalese Twists
shortDesc: Classic two-strand twists with a smooth, polished finish.
description: A protective style staple. Smooth, structured twists that hold their shape for weeks.

name: Starter Locs (Two-Strand Twist Method)
shortDesc: Begin your loc journey with a clean two-strand twist start.
description: Includes a consultation to plan size and parting based on your hair type and lifestyle.

name: Loc Retwist & Style
shortDesc: Tidy new growth and finish with a style of your choice.
description: Retwist with interlocking or palm-rolling, plus a finishing style (barrel rolls, updo, or freestyle).

name: Kids' Braids (under 12)
shortDesc: Gentle, age-appropriate styles for little ones.
description: Cornrows, two-strand twists, or simple box braids. Snacks and a tablet welcome.
